g.text: Conditional FGF1–MT3 association: b = +0.182 per mediator SD, p = 2.91e-06, BH FDR = 0.000283 | Dx attenuation = 19.6%
Values remove centered age, sex and SpD effects; middle panel also removes the centered mediator effect.
ΔDx = SCZ − NTC. P-values/FDR are from the original donor-blocked limma fits; boxes supply no new statistical tests.
Each point is a donor–SpD observation; multiple points from one donor are not independent. Shared outcome y-axis.
Selection: Representative of MT1G/MT1M/MT3-driven metal-response GO terms in the all-tested-background analysis, matching the manuscript vascular metal-homeostasis
theme. Include both FGF1 and FGF2 pairs for comparison.
